explanations: The degraded preview (no deductions, netCents null, degraded: ["benefits"]) is cached with the same 15-minute TTL as a complete one. After a brief benefits outage or a single slow call, every request for that employee and period keeps getting the degraded preview for up to 15 minutes even though the benefits service has recovered. Degraded results should be cached for a short time or not at all (e.g. only cache when degraded.length === 0).

The catch block swallows the error and records "benefits" in degraded; deductions stays []. So preTax is 0 and tax is estimated on the full gross. netCents is only computed when degraded is empty, so it is null. It does not throw, it does not present a misleading net figure, and tax is still estimated.

Without deductions, gross - tax would overstate take-home pay. Returning null with a degraded marker lets the UI show what is known and say what is missing. The tax estimator does run (on full gross); serialization and retries are unrelated.

Promise.race only stops waiting; nothing passes an AbortSignal to fetch, so the request continues and its eventual result is discarded. clearTimeout only cancels the timer. A rejection of the losing promise is handled by race's internal subscription, so it is not unhandled.
